title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery: Starting Figure for Withholding Proposals of Veterans Pension Recipients
content:
For a debtor who holds a running **Veterans Pension** award paid monthly, the figure a reduced-withholding proposal on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** starts from is a share of the latest monthly pension payment.

**Rule.** When the debtor holds a running Veterans Pension award paid monthly and a request carrying a Financial Status Report was received on the debt in the last six calendar months counted back from today, the proposal starts from the report share of 10 percent of the latest monthly pension payment's gross amount. When the debtor holds such a pension award and no request with a report was received in that period, it starts from the no-report share of 25 percent of that payment. A debtor without a running pension award is outside this rule.

**Reading the records.** The pension award's status and its latest monthly payment's gross amount come from the debtor's Veterans Pension records. A request carrying a Financial Status Report is any request on the debt recorded with a report attached, such as a waiver request or a compromise offer. A record falls in the last six calendar months when fewer than six whole calendar months have passed from its date to today: on 20 October, 21 April counts and 20 April does not.

| Running pension paid monthly | Request with a report in the period | Starting figure |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 10 percent of the latest monthly payment's gross amount |
| Yes | No | 25 percent of that gross amount |
| No | Either | Not set by this rule |

**Hypothetical cases.** Latest monthly pension payment of 1,380.00 USD gross, a waiver request with a report received two months ago: starting figure 138.00 USD. The same payment with no report on file in the period: 345.00 USD.
